prompt: Create a finished 16:9 full-frame handmade paper diorama thumbnail. Two large paper stairways rise side by side: the wage stair has two clear levels, the price stair nearly three, and a tiny worker on the lower foreground watches a familiar loaf become harder to reach as the steps grow. Add one prominent silver coin on the wage stair and a paper price tag on the higher stair; no readable numbers. Bold dimensional rounded cut-paper lettering reads exactly “PAY ROSE. SO DID PRICES.” Direct attention from coin to higher price stair with a strong diagonal fold and warm light; keep the two unequal rises unmistakable at phone size. Handmade layered card, visible fibers and cut edges, tactile shadow, limited amber/blue palette, no extra text, no modern items, no photographic look.
visual_intent: The reversal in the script: between the selected London periods, nominal silver wages rise a little over twice while the CPI rises nearly three times, and modeled basket cost increases from 176 to 216 wage-days. At reduced size the unequal stair heights and loaf must read; title makes the reversal explicit.
